title: What Moved the Alarm Score? Causal Attribution with Exact Computation and Scarce-Incident Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2610.27534v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Alarms in industrial systems and scientific instruments often demand immediate diagnosis despite scarce incident data. To guide intervention, an explanation must trace how changes in the data-generating process propagate through the causal structure to alter the alarm score, rather than merely flagging shifts that may be downstream effects. Yet exact attribution across interacting causal components appears combinatorial, while existing methods often either assume an unchanged causal model or require enough incident data to estimate the changed system reliably. We address this setting by formulating the alarm-score change as a Shapley game over hybrid structural causal model (SCM) states. Treating structural functions and exogenous laws as distinct players yields a finer-grained, function/law-resolved report of how each type of change propagates to the alarm score. translated_title: 什么改变了警报分数？基于精确计算与稀疏事件估计的因果归因
translated_abstract: 工业系统和科学仪器中的警报往往需要在事件数据稀少的情况下进行即时诊断。为了指导干预，解释必须追溯数据生成过程中的变化如何通过因果结构传播并改变警报分数，而不仅仅是标记那些可能只是下游效应的偏移。然而，对相互作用的因果组件进行精确归因似乎面临着组合爆炸的难题，而现有方法要么假设因果模型保持不变，要么需要足够的事件数据才能可靠地估计变化后的系统。我们通过将警报分数的变化表述为混合结构因果模型（SCM）状态上的Shapley博弈来应对这一场景。将结构函数和外生规律视为不同的参与者，从而产生更细粒度的、可区分函数与规律的报告，说明每类变化如何传播至警报分数。同一框架还定义了已实现事件报告和总体报告。
tldr: 该论文将警报分数的变化建模为混合结构因果模型状态上的Shapley博弈，把结构函数与外生规律作为不同的博弈参与者，从而在事件数据稀少的条件下实现精确的因果归因，并以函数/规律分辨的细粒度方式解释各类型变化如何传播并影响警报分数。
en_tdlr: The paper formulates alarm-score changes as a Shapley game over hybrid structural causal model states, treating structural functions and exogenous laws as distinct players, enabling exact causal attribution and fine-grained function/law-resolved explanations even with scarce incident data.
